THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
THE STATEMENT
049
67 / Peplum Tweed
Tailored Peplum
A pale blue brushed-tweed jacket and mini skirt with padded
shoulders and a peplum hem, finished with a white satin bow
collar edged in lace. Large silver hoop earrings, grey
over-the-knee socks and black velvet mules complete the set.
68 / Crystal Choker
Runway Jewel
A close runway portrait: dark brown hair swept back from a
center part, light blue-gray eyes and soft peach lips. A layered
crystal choker with a dark stone pendant and long drop earrings
sit above a sheer gown embroidered with gold leaves.
